basis: Actual MCP tools/list and GetToolUsage responses for every tool/operation on all eight releases. Parameterized calls, input origins, result contracts, language files, sequence calls and source hashes checked. sources.scope: Reference material only; relocated skills to stable local skills path, not automatically installed or executed

sources.license: Source code: MIT under LICENSE.md section 2; preserve the complete upstream license
sources.scope: Every C# source file, project dependency file and root build settings; reference text only, never compiled/executed. Sample engineering archives/resources and binaries are not redistributed.
sources.versionEvidence: Pinned source fixtures use .zap21; upstream README still says V20. Neither proves V14 SP1-V20 compatibility.
sources.localModifications: README relative links relocated to pinned upstream URLs; C# sources, project files, build settings and license unchanged.
